packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts.note: All named agent-loop test cases are ported, but source-wide integration and higher-level Agent behavior are separate coverage questions.

packages/agent/src/agent.ts.note: Native agent loop runs model requests and tools; full Agent API and extension integration remain incomplete.

packages/ai/src/api/anthropic-messages.t.note: Ported as three modules: anthropic-messages.bend (AnthropicOptions, getAnthropicCompat, cache control with PI_CACHE_RETENTION, Claude Code tool naming, transformMessages with tool-call id normalization, convertMessages with held-back system messages, consecutive tool results and the last-message cache marker, convertTools with strict JSON-schema tools, native tool changes with the deferred placeholder, getBetaFeatures with header overrides, managed-effort markers, buildParams, streamSimple's option mapping, mapStopReason, createClient's auth and headers; streamSimple's missing-auth error fails before a stream exists, as upstream throws synchronously); anthropic-messages-stream.bend (iterateSseMessages' line decoder with its trailing flush, iterateAnthropicEvents' filtering, repair and parse errors, the event loop with fallback pricing, input transformation diagnostics and the checks after the loop); anthropic-messages-client.bend (the stream lifecycle: injected or created client, onPayload replacement forcing streaming, retryProviderRequest over the shared Stainless request port, onResponse, start, the body loop and the catch block). tests/anthropic_messages_check.py compares 1,692 captured params and wire requests and 21 streamed messages and event sequences with pinned pi-mono, key order included, and runs the ported suites; tests/anthropic_client_loopback.py covers the HTTP path. Approved differences: X-Stainless-* platform headers are not sent (the SDK defaults come from the caller and are empty in the app); options.client is a callback returning status, headers and a body chunk source, and its failures are messages that are not retried; JSON.parse's engine-specific error text is replaced by the native parser's; a failing body read reports undici's "terminated"; event partials are snapshots; an unclosed block does not leak the scratch index field; diagnostic details go through a caller-supplied encoder (the app's details are Unit). No live Anthropic request has been verified.

packages/ai/src/api/bedrock-converse-str.note: Lazy loading of the implementation module through a dynamic import is a JavaScript bundling concern; the Bend runtime dispatches models of this api to bedrock-converse-stream.bend directly (coding-agent agent-runtime selectedProvider).

stream/streamSimple: the client configuration pi builds (profile, region from ARN/AWS_REGION/profile/built-in endpoint, custom endpoints, static credentials, bearer token), message/tool/system conversion with cache points and document sanitization, adaptive and budget thinking fields, onPayload/onResponse, the restJson ConverseStream request with SigV4 (runtime/aws-sigv4.bend) or bearer auth and caller headers minus reserved ones, the event-stream response (runtime/aws-eventstream.bend with CRC-32), the stream fold (text, reasoning incl. redacted, tool calls, usage with 1h cache writes, stop reasons) and error formatting with bedrock_response_failure diagnostics; traces equal the pinned AWS SDK on a loopback server (tests/bedrock_check.py). Without configured credentials the SDK default chain resolves them as the pinned credential-provider-node does (bedrock-credentials.bend over bedrock-credential-services.bend): environment keys unless a profile is selected, shared-file profiles (static keys, STS AssumeRole through source_profile chains and credential_source Environment/EcsContainer/Ec2InstanceMetadata with cycle and MFA errors, AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, credential_process, SSO with sso-session token refresh through SSO-OIDC and legacy start-URL caches), fromProcess, web identity from the environment, then container (fromHttp with token file and retries, fromContainerMetadata) or IMDS (v2 token, v1 fallback and its blocks); tests/bedrock_check.py compares 33 chain cases (including the SDK standard retry strategy on STS and SSO) with the SDK against a loopback STS/SSO/OIDC/ECS/IMDS server. Missing: console login sessions (login_session), the Bedrock ConverseStream request's own SDK retries, and HTTP(S) proxy agents. Unknown content-block types and lone surrogates are not representable in the typed Bend transcript.

packages/ai/src/api/cloudflare-ai-bindin.note: Not ported pending a decision: the module adapts a Cloudflare Workers AI binding (env.AI) into a fetch function plus the CLOUDFLARE_GATEWAY_BINDING_AUTH_SENTINEL header value, which only exist inside a Workers runtime; the native CLI has no binding to wrap. A structural port (an AiBinding value with an optional fetch callback and the sentinel) is possible but has no native caller.

packages/ai/src/api/google-generative-ai.note: Ported as three modules: google-generative-ai.bend (GoogleOptions, streamSimple's option mapping with clamped levels, level-or-budget thinking config and getGoogleBudget, buildParams producing the SDK parameters, client headers, and the SDK's parameter-to-REST conversion with its field order); google-generative-ai-stream.bend (the SDK's processStreamResponse framing with its delimiters, in-band error chunks and incomplete-segment error, and the chunk fold: text/thinking block transitions, signatures, function calls with generated ids, responseId, usage and finish reasons); google-generative-ai-client.bend (streamSimple's missing-key and level-mapping errors fail before a stream exists, as upstream throws synchronously; the stream lifecycle: custom-fetch (accepting the process fetch handle, globalThis.fetch upstream) and API-key checks, onPayload replacement, the SDK model path and address, headers, retryProviderRequest with status-only failures, the body loop and the catch block). tests/google_generative_ai_check.py compares 560 captured params, wire requests and streamed messages/event sequences with pinned pi-mono and runs the ported suites; tests/google_client_loopback.py covers the HTTP path and the agent glue. Documented differences: x-goog-api-client carries the SDK label without the gl-node/<process.version> runtime label (there is no Node runtime); JSON.parse's engine-specific error text is replaced by the native parser's; event partials are snapshots. No live Gemini request has been verified. Generated tool-call ids use one counter shared by every stream of an agent runtime (a Ref in its provider configuration; the CLI process has one runtime), as upstream's module toolCallCounter; tests/ai-misc-suites.bend checks that a second stream continues the sequence. The SDK's tContents rejection of an empty contents list ('contents are required', before any request) is ported in prepareRequest (found by tests/live_replay_check.py).

packages/ai/src/api/google-shared.ts.note: Ported to google-shared.bend: Google thinking levels and their resolution/validation messages, usesGoogleThinkingLevel, disabled thinking config, thought-signature retention and validation, Gemini version rules (tool call ids, multimodal function responses, strict tool sampling), convertMessages (transformMessages with id normalization, signed/unsigned replay, empty-block handling, consecutive function responses, legacy image turns), sanitizeForOpenApi, convertTools with strict schemas, mapToolChoice, resolveGoogleFunctionCallingMode and mapStopReason/mapStopReasonString. Covered by the ported google-shared-* suites and the Google differential in tests/google_generative_ai_check.py. The Vertex caller is not ported, so Vertex-only paths are exercised only through the shared functions.

packages/ai/src/api/google-vertex.lazy.t.note: Lazy loading of the implementation module through a dynamic import is a JavaScript bundling concern; the Bend runtime dispatches models of this api to google-vertex.bend directly (coding-agent agent-runtime selectedProvider).

packages/ai/src/api/google-vertex.ts.note: stream/streamSimple: the custom-fetch check, resolveApiKey (ADC markers and placeholders), the API key or ADC client with project/location from options and env, buildHttpOptions (custom base URL at collection scope, version detection, User-Agent and header overlay), buildParams shared with Google Generative AI, onPayload, the SDK's Vertex URL, headers and request conversion, retryGoogleRequest, and the shared stream loop with the api name and 'Google Vertex stream ended without a finish reason'; streamSimple without a key requirement and with Vertex's 2.5 Flash-Lite budgets. ADC as google-auth-library 10.6.2 resolves it (google-vertex-credentials.bend): the keyFilename (with fromStreamAsync's fallback to a JSON JWT key file), else the well-known gcloud file, else the Compute Engine metadata server (gcp-metadata residency probe, METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION, ping, token; google-metadata.bend); authorized_user refresh, gtoken's RS256 JWT grant (runtime/rsa-sign.bend), impersonated_service_account (generateAccessToken with the source credentials and its error formats), external_account (file, URL, AWS SigV4 GetCallerIdentity and executable subject tokens, the STS token exchange with client authentication and workforce options, service account impersonation) and external_account_authorized_user (google-external-account.bend); GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT; project discovery on the ADC path (environment, gcloud config-helper, metadata project-id, an external account's Cloud Resource Manager lookup); gaxios' retry policy for auth and metadata requests (credential-http.bend). tests/google_vertex_check.py compares 17 streamed cases and 32 credential cases with upstream driving the pinned @google/genai and google-auth-library on loopback servers and asserts the 12 client-configuration cases. Differences: certificate (mTLS) subject tokens are refused (no client certificates in the TLS client); PEM keyFilename fallbacks are refused (no client email to sign with); where upstream's fallback JWT lacks scopes only because fromJSON did not mutate the shared options object, upstream signs a self-signed JWT without a key ('key must be a string, a buffer or an object') and the port reports gtoken's 'private_key and client_email are required.'; the x-goog-api-client value omits gl-node/<version>; METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION's unexpected-error warning is not printed; the metadata ping tries the link-local address, then the DNS name, in sequence rather than racing them; OAuth2Client's re-authorization retry on 401/403 (only for tokens without expiry) is not reproduced.

packages/ai/src/api/mistral-conversation.note: Lazy loading of the implementation module through a dynamic import is a JavaScript bundling concern; the Bend runtime dispatches models of this api to mistral-conversations.bend directly (coding-agent agent-runtime selectedProvider).

stream/streamSimple: transcript resolution, Mistral tool-call id normalization, SDK-style payload and wire renaming, pi User-Agent and header overrides with x-affinity, the request timeout over the whole exchange, onPayload/onResponse, Mistral SSE framing, the chunk fold (text/thinking/tool calls, cached-token usage, stop reasons) and error formatting, all checked against upstream traces (tests/mistral_check.py). packages/ai/src/api/openai-codex-respons.note: SSE transport ported to packages/ai/src/api/openai-codex-responses.bend: stream/streamSimple (missing key fails before a stream exists), the shared buildRequestBody through Responses.prepare with the Codex endpoint, onPayload, normalizeTimeoutMs, the fetch-with-retry loop (maxRetries default 0; isRetryableError with terminal usage-limit texts; retry-after-ms/retry-after seconds or HTTP date; validateRetryDelayMs; 1s exponential backoff; failures retried unless aborted, delay-exceeded or 'usage limit'), the header-only timeout message, onResponse, parseErrorResponse's friendly ChatGPT usage-limit message, parseSSE (\n\n frames, data lines, [DONE], EOF terminating the residual frame, 'Invalid Codex SSE JSON'), mapCodexEvents (Codex error events, response.failed, response.done/completed/incomplete normalized to response.completed with endTurn, stopping at the first terminal event) and resolveCodexServiceTier pricing over the shared processResponsesStream. The agent's provider seam dispatches openai-codex-responses models here. tests/openai_codex_stream_check.py compares 24 named test instances and 3 native error cases with pinned pi-mono over a loopback server. Not ported: the WebSocket transport (sessions, caching, fallback bookkeeping) and zstd request bodies (upstream sends plain JSON when zstd is unavailable). Documented differences: JSON.parse's engine error text is the native parser's; the fetch implementation's error message is 'fetch failed' (Node's).

packages/ai/src/api/openai-completions.t.note: Request and stream sides ported. Request: ResolvedOpenAICompletionsCompat with detectCompat/getCompat; convertMessages (tool-call id normalization, thinking replay fields and reasoning_details, the four requires* flags, grammar tool calls, Kimi mid-conversation tools); convertTools with grammar custom tools; buildParams in upstream field order with every thinkingFormat, budgets, cache markers, routing and sampling overrides; createClient's headers including GitHub Copilot's dynamic headers. Stream: the chunk loop (text, thinking and tool-call blocks by wire index or id, custom grammar input, streamed reasoning_details, reasoning-field signatures with OpenCode Go's normalization, routed responseModel, parseChunkUsage), block endings and finish_reason checks with the supportsFinishReason: false fallback; the lifecycle over the shared SDK port (getClientApiKey, onPayload, retried request, onResponse, SDK SSE with in-chunk errors, abort as stopReason aborted, the catch block's message with OpenRouter metadata.raw appended as String(raw)). Byte-identical to upstream on the suites' named cases, native cases for Copilot headers, raw metadata kinds and mid-stream abort, 724 generated requests and 114 generated streams (tests/openai_completions_request_check.py, tests/openai_completions_stream_check.py). streamSimpleOptions returns getClientApiKey's missing-auth error before a stream exists, as upstream throws.

packages/ai/src/api/openai-prompt-cache..note: clampOpenAIPromptCacheKey keeps 64 code points (surrogate pairs normalized first); exercised by the prompt-cache suite's clamping case through the Completions request.

packages/ai/src/api/openai-responses.ts.note: Native OpenAI/Codex request and stream path works; provider suites remain partial and some upstream request/header behavior differs. Codex models run their own SSE lifecycle in openai-codex-responses.bend (see its review); preparation stays here. streamSimple returns the missing-auth error before a stream exists (upstream getClientApiKey throws; for Codex models the plain-key check of openai-codex-responses.ts streamSimple).

packages/ai/src/api/openrouter-images.la.note: openrouterImagesApi: the ProviderImages value is a callback over the native transport (openrouter-images.bend openrouterImagesApi); there is no lazy module import, and a request without a signal runs under a local signal that never aborts.

packages/ai/src/api/openrouter-images.ts.note: generateImages: the missing-key error, buildParams (sanitized text parts, data-URL image parts, stream false, modalities from the model's outputs), the OpenAI SDK client over openai-client.bend (bearer auth, model then option headers with nulls dropped, the request timeout), onPayload replacement, retryProviderRequest around one SDK attempt, onResponse after the body is read, responseId, parseUsage with cache reads/writes and per-million pricing, the first choice's text and data-URL images, and error/aborted results with the formatted provider error; tests/openrouter_images_check.py compares 14 cases with upstream images.ts driving the pinned OpenAI SDK. packages/ai/src/api/pi-messages.lazy.ts.note: Lazy loading of the implementation module through a dynamic import is a JavaScript bundling concern; the Bend runtime dispatches models of this api to pi-messages.bend directly (coding-agent agent-runtime selectedProvider).

packages/ai/src/api/pi-messages.ts.note: stream/streamSimple, payload, headers, onPayload/onResponse, SSE framing, event conversion, rewrite and response-failure diagnostics and createErrorEvent are ported and checked against upstream traces (tests/pi_messages_check.py). Native adaptations: streamSimple takes debug as an argument (upstream reads it from a cast options object); unknown event types are skipped rather than forwarded; content blocks placed past the end are appended instead of making a sparse array; malformed JSON/events and transport failures report native messages; fetch runs under a deadline scope that never expires (the maximum U32 milliseconds), as upstream passes only the caller's signal.

packages/ai/src/auth/credential-store.ts.note: The injectable CredentialStore interface and persistent auth.json store exist, but the public default InMemoryCredentialStore and its per-provider serialized modify/delete behavior do not.

packages/ai/src/auth/helpers.ts.note: Standard API-key providers prompt through ProviderAuthInteraction with a SecretPrompt and resolve stored credentials before environment variables. Empty keys are rejected. Cloudflare auth regressions validate the migrated shared prompt contract on Bun/native1/native4. The lazy OAuth helper remains absent.

packages/ai/src/auth/oauth/anthropic.ts.note: Native OAuthAuth.login uses PKCE, the upstream authorization URL, callback host override, browser/manual arbitration, progress notification and authorization-code exchange. Refresh retains the five-minute expiry margin and toAuth derives bearer auth. Native callback/manual fixtures check state rejection, cancellation, typed prompt failures and occupied-port fallback; the PKCE oracle checks generated challenges. Callback completion HTML is simplified; exact token-error classification/rendering and source-wide edge-case parity remain incomplete.

packages/ai/src/auth/oauth/device-code.t.note: pollOAuthDeviceCodeFlow over a poll callback: the default and minimum intervals, the optional first wait, slow_down with the server's interval or +5 s, the expiry deadline with upstream's two timeout messages, and cancellation ('Login cancelled'); used by the Radius device login. abortableSleep is Timer.sleep under the signal.

packages/ai/src/auth/oauth/openai-codex..note: Native OAuthAuth.login selects browser/device login. Browser authorization uses PKCE, independent 16-byte hex state, upstream URL fields, callback host override, state validation, manual-input fallback and token exchange with the browser redirect URI. Device login notifies the user code then polls/exchanges with the device redirect URI. Refresh and toAuth remain native. Browser/manual workers share typed first-settlement arbitration and are cancelled/joined before disposal. Callback completion HTML is simplified; exact token-error classification/rendering and source-wide edge-case parity remain incomplete.

packages/ai/src/auth/oauth/pkce.ts.note: Native generatePKCE reads 32 secure random bytes, base64url-encodes the verifier and SHA-256 challenge, and returns immutable PKCE fields. Failures are typed errors. tests/anthropic_oauth_start_check.py compares native one/four-thread authorization challenges with the Python SHA-256/base64 oracle; browser interaction tests exercise worker cleanup.

packages/ai/src/auth/oauth/radius.ts.note: createRadiusOAuth: the sign-in method select, device login (POST /v1/oauth/device, device_code event, polling the token endpoint with authorization_pending/slow_down/expired_token/access_denied), browser login (GET /v1/oauth discovery, PKCE with a random-UUID state, the callback server on 127.0.0.1:1456 with upstream's 404/state-mismatch/missing-code responses and error completion, progress and auth_url events, the code exchange), refresh through the gateway, OAuthResponseError messages and toAuth; tests/radius_check.py (the three upstream cases plus the full browser callback flow). Native differences: the success/error pages are plain HTML with upstream's messages (the styled oauth-page template is not ported); a token response missing access_token/refresh_token/expires_in is an error instead of a credential with undefined fields.

packages/ai/src/auth/types.ts.note: Credential storage and provider auth resolution have native types. AuthPrompt covers text, secret, selection and manual code with optional per-prompt cancellation; AuthEvent covers info/links, authorization URLs, device codes and progress. AuthInteraction accepts an optional signal; ProviderAuthInteraction carries a required signal. OAuthAuth.login is required, and both API-key and OAuth callbacks use prompt/notify interactions. ApiKeyAuth.check and the remaining auth-context contract are incomplete.

packages/ai/src/bedrock-provider.ts.note: A package entry point that re-exports stream/streamSimple so Bun-compiled binaries can preload the Bedrock module (coding-agent bun/runtime-setup.ts); Bend modules import api/bedrock-converse-stream.bend directly.

packages/ai/src/env-api-keys.ts.note: Ported to packages/ai/src/env-api-keys.bend: getApiKeyEnvVars (the provider table, Copilot's COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN and Anthropic's AUTH/OAUTH/API order), findEnvKeys, getEnvApiKey (skipping ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ambient Vertex ADC and Bedrock credentials as '<authenticated>') over getProviderEnvValue. tests/env_api_keys_check.py runs the named suite and compares 410 provider/environment cases with pinned pi-mono. Documented difference: upstream memoizes the default gcloud ADC file check in a module variable; the port checks the file on each call. The CLI resolves keys through the providers' auth helpers, so this module is not on its request path.

packages/ai/src/image-models.generated.t.note: Generated from the pinned image-models.generated.ts by scripts/generate-model-catalog.py --images; tests/openrouter_images_check.py compares all 55 models with it.

packages/ai/src/images-models.ts.note: ImagesProvider/createImagesProvider (name defaulting to the id, last-known catalog, refreshModels with in-flight sharing: a call that waited for a concurrent refresh shares its outcome), and ImagesModels: set/delete/clear providers as value transitions (replacement keeps the position), getProviders/getProvider/getModels/getModel, refresh with model_source failures for one provider and best-effort concurrent refresh of all, getAuth through resolveProviderAuth, and generateImages with auth resolution and per-field option merging (unknown providers and auth rejections become error results). All six images-models.test.ts cases pass (packages/ai/test/images-models.bend). Missing: createImagesModels' defaults (InMemoryCredentialStore and defaultProviderAuthContext); callers pass the store and context.

packages/ai/src/images.ts.note: generateImages through the registered api provider; a missing provider is a failure with upstream's message. The registry is passed in instead of being filled by importing register-builtins.

Provider, RefreshModelsContext and ModelsPublication have native representations and fetched-catalog helpers. The standalone Models/MutableModels collection is not exposed in pi-ai: much of its catalog, auth, refresh and request behavior currently lives in coding-agent ModelRuntime/agent-runtime. packages/ai/src/providers/mistral.models.note: Generated from pi-ai's mistral.json by scripts/generate-model-catalog.py; tests/model-catalog.bend dumps all 33 models equal to the pinned data.

packages/ai/src/providers/mistral.ts.note: The Mistral provider with its MISTRAL_API_KEY auth, base URL and catalog, listed in providers/all.bend in upstream order.

packages/ai/src/providers/radius-config..note: DEFAULT_RADIUS_GATEWAY, normalizeRadiusGatewayUrl, the gateway config sanitization (isRadiusGatewayModel's checks, well-formed models kept), getRadiusCredentialConfig from an OAuth credential's gatewayConfig, getRadiusModelsFromConfig/getRadiusModels and loadRadiusGatewayConfig (GET /v1/config with the bearer key, truncated error bodies) over an injected fetch; tests/radius_check.py. packages/ai/src/providers/radius.ts.note: radiusProvider: id/name/gateway options, the public catalog for the default gateway only, RADIUS_API_KEY and Radius OAuth auth, pi-messages streams, and refreshModels (restore the stored catalog, import a legacy credential catalog, then load the gateway config when the network is allowed, persisting it); providers/all.bend lists it in upstream order and model-runtime configureRadiusProviders builds models.json oauth-radius gateways. The OAuth and config HTTP client is injected (Radius.RadiusTransport). tests/radius_check.py runs radius-provider.test.ts and coding-agent radius.test.ts.

packages/ai/src/utils/uuid.ts.note: uuidv7 keeps upstream's process-wide monotonic sequence (seeded once from 40 random bits, 2^41-1 exhaustion), clamps ordinary clock rollback, preserves follower timestamps and rejects timestamps outside integers 0..2^48-1. The module state is an explicit State with a pure transition; a Generator owns it in a Ref. Bend has no module globals, so the process generator is created once by main (or by --export) and reaches session creation through the session value, AgentSession summaries and the session picker. Entropy failure is a Bend-only error result.

packages/coding-agent/src/cli/initial-me.note: buildInitialMessage: stdin content (when present), non-empty @file text and the first CLI message join into the initial prompt; the remaining messages are returned instead of shifted off parsed.messages. main.bend passes its result to print and interactive startup. tests/initial-message.bend ports initial-message.test.ts.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-ses.note: Native sessions run, and extension context binding, commands and provider refresh are now present; v0.87.1 compaction cancellation (de2de549b) is ported except the summarization-auth abort signal; prompt images and tool-result images are normalized with the image setting and the current model's resize profile (f5c946480). sendCustomMessage (nextTurn, steer/followUp while streaming, deferral to turn_end without triggerTurn, triggerTurn runs) and sendUserMessage (expandPromptTemplates) are ported with the pending custom-message flushes at turn_end, run settlement and prompt, and bound as the extension runtime's sendMessage/sendUserMessage actions. Extension events: agent/turn_start/message/tool_execution events reach extensions before listeners, message_end replacements are persisted and projected, tool_call and tool_result run in the agent's tool hooks, agent_settled precedes the public event; navigateTree runs session_before_tree (cancel, supplied summary, instruction and label overrides) under the branch-summary controller and emits session_tree; manual and automatic compaction run session_before_compact (cancel or supplied result), then session_compact or session_compact_failed; waitForIdle waits for session-level idleness (no run, compaction or branch summary). turn_end boundaries run from the agent's finishTurn (or the turn_end event for synthesized failures) and agent_before_settle before settlement, with drafts previewed, committed and announced after the context refresh; post-run handling continues for queued messages only after retry and compaction (no queue drain before retry). The agent's transformContext runs the extensions' context handlers; getUserMessagesForForking, pendingMessageCount and harness-style appendSessionEntry/refreshSessionContext are present. prompt() follows upstream's order: extension command, compaction refusal, input handlers (source interactive/rpc/extension; streamingBehavior only while streaming), expansion, queue while streaming, then pending flushes and the preflight (formatNoModelSelectedMessage / formatNoApiKeyFoundMessage with the package docs path; the OAuth wording is unreachable because its snapshot entry exists exactly when hasConfiguredAuth holds); preflightResult reports acceptance before anything runs. Queued steer/followUp input passes the input handlers; upstream's refusal of extension commands there is not ported (steer/followUp report no failure). setShutdownHandler binds ctx.shutdown(). before_agent_start runs after the preflight: handler messages follow the user message and next-turn messages; changed options (_runSystemPromptOptions) render the run's prompt and select its tools from the registry, next turns re-render them with the agent's tools, and a forced systemPrompt is sent as the request's one leading system message after the context handlers (_installAgentForcedPromptProjection); images are normalized for the model the handlers left selected. The extension setModel action switches only with configured auth. Missing: session_start/switch/fork/shutdown extension events, user_bash, _isEmittingAgentSettled deferral, and replaced messages inside turn_end/agent_end payloads. The skill-block parser used by restored transcripts is in core/skills.bend. Native appendLabelChange exposes session-manager label mutation through shared session ownership, using the existing atomic metadata append/persistence path.

AgentSessionRuntime: create (session_start startup once installed), newSession, switchSession, resumeSession, importFromJsonl and fork (before a user message or at an entry; persisted sessions branch into a new file, in-memory ones in place), setRebindSession, setBeforeSessionInvalidate and dispose. Replacement emits session_before_switch/session_before_fork first (cancellable through the *Cancellable variants; newSession/switchSession/fork keep results without cancellation for hosts not yet reporting it), then teardown (abort, session_shutdown with the target file, the before-invalidate hook, dispose), the factory for the next session, rebind, and session_start (upstream: the mode's bindExtensions). Missing: withSession/setup continuations and ReplacedSessionContext, cancellation for resumeSession/importFromJsonl (their outcome types have no cancelled variant yet), stale extension contexts after replacement, diagnostics and modelFallbackMessage.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/auth-guid.note: All four messages; callers pass the docs directory where upstream reads its package location (config.ts getDocsPath). Not yet used by AgentSession.prompt's preflight (see tests/rpc.md).

packages/coding-agent/src/core/export-ht.note: Native session snapshot and browser assets are ported. Interactive HTML export uses the active resolved theme, including missing-configured-theme fallback, with light/dark palette checks. Custom tool HTML rendering and standalone/RPC theme parity remain unverified.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/extension.note: Inline factories load into a runtime (loadExtensionFromFactory/loadExtensionFactories) with registerCommand, registerProvider/unregisterProvider (deferred while loading), on/unsubscribe, sendMessage, sendUserMessage with its options and setModel (failing before the session binds them with upstream's not-initialized message). No file discovery or jiti loading (JS extensions are excluded; extensions are compiled Bend). Missing: registerTool/Shortcut/Flag/renderers, appendEntry, session name/label, active tools, model and thinking actions, events bus.

Native ExtensionRunner: bindCore/bindCommandContext/setUIContext, command resolution with invocation names, error listeners, snapshotEventHandlers, emit for events without results, emitMessageEnd (same-role replacement chain), emitToolCall (first block wins, failures propagate), emitToolResult (patched fields), and the session_before_tree/session_before_compact results of emit (last result, cancel stops dispatch, failures reported). emitBoundary (turn_end/agent_before_settle: drafts and continuation carried between handlers, a preview rebuilt after each, invalid drafts reported). emitContext (context handlers on the conversation with system messages restored, then context_with_system; unchanged is structural equality). emitInput (each handler sees the input as the previous ones left it; handled stops dispatch; failures reported; transform when a handler transformed, not by array identity). emitBeforeAgentStart (messages collected, a returned systemPrompt forces the prompt, returned options replace the event's for later handlers since native handlers cannot edit them in place; systemPrompt is rendered for each handler). emit for session_start/session_shutdown and the cancelling session_before_switch/session_before_fork dispatch (stops at the first cancel). Missing: emitUserBash, provider request/header events, emitCacheWarmingDecision, emitResourcesDiscover, shortcuts, flags, renderers, tool registrations, invalidate/stale contexts.

Typed native events and results for agent_start/end/settled, turn_start, message_start/update/end, tool_execution_*, tool_call, tool_result, session_before_tree/session_tree (TreePreparation, summary and instruction overrides), session_before_compact/session_compact/session_compact_failed, turn_end/agent_before_settle boundaries (SessionBoundaryDraft, BoundaryContextPreview, BoundaryResult, AgentActivityOutcome), commands, InlineExtension, ExtensionError and the sendMessage/sendUserMessage actions. tool_call input is one JSON value, not upstream's per-tool narrowed variants; compaction details are the typed read/modified file lists. context/context_with_system (results carry messages; no in-place edits). input (InputEvent/InputSource/InputEventResult; no images is an empty list) and sendUserMessage's options (deliverAs, expandPromptTemplates). before_agent_start (BeforeAgentStartEvent/Result; the result also carries edited options) and the setModel action. session_start, session_before_switch, session_before_fork (with Ctx.ForkPosition) and session_shutdown with their results. Missing: session_info events, user_bash, model/thinking select, provider request/response, UI prompt events, tools/shortcuts/flags/renderer registration types.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-m.note: Session persistence, resume, tree and fork work; complete upstream session/recovery parity is not claimed.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/bas.note: Native Bash execution and interactive streaming work; the tool now reads live session context, while output preview and exact terminal parity retain known gaps.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/edi.note: Native edit execution works; complete upstream edit behavior is not established by the current source review.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/pat.note: expandPath, resolveToCwd and resolveReadPath (existing path, then AM/PM, NFD, curly-quote and NFD+curly variants) live in utils/paths.bend; the whole upstream path-utils suite passes (tests/paths.bend). resolveReadPathAsync is the same IO function; pathExists is FS.accessible.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/ren.note: Width-aware five-visual-line tail previews, skipped-line counts and ordinary bash snapshots match upstream; the broader renderer contract is not yet fully validated.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/wri.note: Native write execution works; complete upstream source contract has not been reviewed.

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interact.note: The fullscreen transcript scrolls independently of the dock and matches page/wheel parity. Pending/status/widget dock sections and configurable scrollbar settings remain open.

Assistant text/thinking rendering, stream updates, independent thinking-run clicks, global reset, mouse hit regions, output padding and stop errors are ported. Markdown extension transformers and their streaming/width context remain incomplete.

Collapsed/expanded Markdown rendering, token count, theme and mouse toggle are present; broader terminal-frame parity remains unverified.

Native timer rounds positive durations up to seconds, calls the initial tick, decrements every second, expires once and cancels/joins on disposal. Retry tick/disposal is exercised by the status suite. Zero duration completes immediately at zero instead of emitting a negative tick a second later; independent expiry/optional-redraw callback tests remain unported.
Displayed text messages use the default themed Markdown box and hidden messages are omitted. Extension-supplied custom renderers and output-pad changes are not yet ported.

Native footer renders session/model/thinking, usage, context and status data. Auto-compaction state is refreshed from the live session on render and its enabled marker matches the settings-toggle terminal scenario. Full source-wide callback, subscription and extension-status parity remains unverified. Run/retry/compaction lifecycle events preserve extension status data; their indicators render in the editor border.

Provider login uses native AuthPrompt/AuthEvent and shared TUI Input. Selection returns the option ID directly and restores preceding dialog content. Text, secret and manual-code prompts preserve notifications; authorization URLs and messages wrap with the TUI ANSI wrapper while retaining their full hyperlink targets. Submission keeps immutable displayed content and masks secrets while returning their raw value. Per-prompt cancellation races removable observations, joins its watchers and leaves the parent signal active. Input and browser-interaction fixtures exercise editing, notifications, selection, browser/manual arbitration and cancellation. Full mouse behavior and completion-page/UI parity remain unreviewed.

Native /model selector matches upstream scoped browsing, search, current-model marking, real catalog refresh status, and save-as-default including custom bindings in terminal parity. The All-tab filter matches text but has three ANSI row-reset differences. Multi-catalog refresh failure, timeout/cancellation, mouse behavior, and the full upstream suite remain open.

Login menus derive account and API-key options from registered providers, including API-key methods configured outside Pi. Options sort by native locale collation and search provider name, ID, auth type and method name. Mixed menus label auth types even after filtering; typed selections preserve both provider and method. The provider list uses an eight-row window, configured/source badges and alternate-auth warnings. Provider-menu Escape returns to the auth-type menu; direct unknown names open a mixed searchable menu. Native component tests exercise filtering, method identity and cancellation. Provider catalog completeness, cached auth-status ownership, logout-selector styling and mouse behavior remain partial.

The native /scoped-models picker matches upstream selection, clear/enable/provider controls, save, close, and model cycling in terminal parity. Refresh cancellation, unavailable-pattern resolution, reorder/mouse interactions, and remaining ANSI/viewport details are not yet verified or matched.

Native resume lists use indexed session trees ordered by the latest activity in each subtree, with stable sibling ordering. Sort/named filters retain a clamped position, and loaded scope changes retain the selected path. The renderer preserves named/current/delete-confirmation colors, tree connectors and narrow path/empty-state truncation. The modal reads the live session file and resolves loaded path aliases before allowing deletion. Pinned component comparisons cover these behaviors, confirmation input interception and full ANSI frames. Interactive rename and progressive/cancellable startup loading have terminal checks. Interactive resume opens without an eager scan, loads current rows progressively and requests All lazily; closing joins cancelled workers before reopening. Deferred-load comparisons cover untouched/touched selection, inactive-scope completion, scope caches and full loading frames on Bun/native1/native4. Canonical parent links across symlink aliases, status expiry, mouse controls and remaining upstream callback assertions are pending. Bun/native1/native4 component comparisons match. Native1/native4 mounted terminal comparisons match active-session rejection, confirmation cancellation, actual deletion and reopen, preserved drafts and following requests; the rename regression matches too. Native1/native4 mounted scope/filter/close/reopen/draft/following-request comparisons match pi. Successful rename/delete cancels and joins the old scans, invalidates inactive rows and reloads only the active scope; each other scope remains lazy. Rename stays open through the refresh and cannot begin while that scope is loading. Real-file comparisons cover cross-scope stale-name/deleted-row prevention on Bun/native1/native4.

Native theme and per-model thinking submenus save and clear settings, with live preview or current-model thinking updates. Hardware-cursor and clear-on-shrink choices persist and update the running terminal; disabling the cursor hides it immediately. Live updates coalesce through the owned render scheduler, preserving independent preferences and avoiding serial-state re-entry from input callbacks. Native one/four-thread PTY tests cover visibility, coalescing, setter return order and terminal restoration; focused settings terminal captures match pi. Other settings controls, some ANSI styling and mouse behavior remain partial.
The exported yes/no image-display selector is absent; showImages can be changed through the settings panel instead.
Restored skill invocations are parsed into a collapsible card and separate user prompt; mouse toggle works. Broader terminal-frame parity remains unverified.

Native typed Working, Retry, Compaction and BranchSummary indicators preserve standalone/embedded rendering, theme colors, custom working color/frames, reason labels, kind, spinner rendering and retry countdown disposal. Owned resources and borrowed appearance callbacks replace class inheritance; IdleStatus is a pure two-row rendering function. Interactive callers are tracked separately.

Native settings theme submenu previews, cancels, saves and configures automatic light/dark themes; a filename/content-name mismatch appears correctly in the menu. User-theme startup notices and filename/content-name differences match terminal captures. Standalone exported API, preview header redraw, remaining ANSI styling and mouse details are partial.
The interactive picker matches upstream terminal frames for search, selection and save-as-default; mouse input and the full navigation/cancellation contract remain unverified.

Filtering reconnects hidden ancestors; search/filter transitions preserve selection through empty results. Keyboard movement, paging, folding, branch jumps, confirmation, cancellation and full-message copying are implemented. Native1/native4 differential checks compare selection, actions and full ANSI frames for linear, branching, multiple-root and hidden-metadata trees, narrow semantic help wrapping, previews and empty filters. Label timestamps, standalone mounting/delayed empty cancellation, independent initial selection and remaining upstream assertions are pending. Label editing uses native Input with focus/cursor state, paste, word editing and explicit save/cancel transitions. Saving rebuilds the immutable nodes while preserving entries, topology, selection and current filter membership; empty labels remove the label. Component comparisons cover rendering, saved values, cancellation and removal. Native1/native4 mounted terminal comparisons match label entry/cursor styling, word navigation, save/reopen/cancel/removal, preserved draft and the following model request. Tool results look up typed arguments from hidden or visible assistant calls and display read ranges, home-relative paths, command/search previews and custom-tool JSON. Pinned component comparisons cover these descriptions, unknown calls, filters, full-message copying and narrow ANSI frames on Bun/native1/native4. Native1/native4 mounted terminal comparisons match read/bash descriptions after actual tool execution, filtering, copying, draft restoration and the following model request.

Immutable UserMessageList and UserMessageSelectorComponent preserve chronological items, initial selection/fallback, wraparound movement, confirm/cancel actions, ten-message scrolling, text normalization/truncation and themed component rendering. Native1/native4 differential checks compare full ANSI output and actions with the pinned component. The interactive modal owns selection callbacks and routes chosen IDs through the existing fork runtime. Native1/native4 mounted checks verify restored drafts, edited submissions, original-history isolation and terminal restoration. Standalone component mounting and its delayed empty-list cancellation are not yet ported.

Native POSIX helper preserves the command arguments, launching notice, private pi-editor temporary directory/prompt.md, exit-code gating, leading-BOM/single-final-newline normalization and cleanup. Native1/native4 syscall/foreground-PTY checks and actual upstream helper comparisons cover successful, failed and empty edits. Filesystem/encoding failures return Failed; malformed UTF-8 is rejected rather than replaced, following the agreed strict-input policy. JS execution is unsupported for these native process effects. Interactive Ctrl+g and terminal suspension/resume are tracked separately in interactive-mode.

Interactive theme, thinking, scoped-model and model selection flows work. Native provider-directed API-key and OAuth login uses ModelRuntime.login, prompt/notify callbacks and shared cancellation. Registered providers supply menus and custom account-login labels; direct provider IDs/display names match without case sensitivity, and dual-method providers offer account/API-key selection. Codex offers browser/device authorization and Anthropic browser/manual authorization. Fullscreen startup, typing, viewport scrolling, and keyboard transcript search match focused terminal captures; regular Ctrl+D exit and persisted-session resume hint match. Resumed-session tool warnings precede restored messages, though startup remains slower. Fullscreen exit text and spacing match upstream on untouched and completed-turn sessions; cursor/border styling, mouse selection, dynamic mode switching and broader commands remain partial. Exact /model matches use the cached scoped or available list; misses refresh the catalog with a 15-second abort deadline, retry exact matching, then open the filtered picker. The miss picker matches plain terminal frames; prefilled search cursor styling remains different. Interactive HTML export now uses the active theme palette and explicit export backgrounds. Resumed transcripts now render compaction and branch summaries, displayed custom messages, and skill invocations in sequence; live structural entries use the same path. The footer reads live auto-compaction state, so disabling it removes the auto marker immediately. User-theme resource notices match compact and expanded terminal captures, quiet startup and reload refresh; context sections retain their extra spacer. Prompt/extension listings, project/package theme sources and broader resource diagnostics remain incomplete. Working/retry/compaction statuses use native owned loaders and countdowns; retry countdown and Escape cancellation have terminal comparisons. Manual compaction completion rebuilds retained context and appends the summary chronologically; completion, Escape cancellation and the following model request match focused terminal comparisons. Initial branch-summary status and broader compaction queue/progress/cost-notice integration remain incomplete. API-key login now accepts all native AuthPrompt kinds, provider notifications and per-prompt cancellation. Pasted API-key prompt/save terminal captures and the basic request loop match pi. Broader provider catalog and secret-masking parity remain partial. Hardware-cursor and clear-on-shrink settings update the running TUI after successful persistence; cursor disabling hides immediately, and focused setting/persistence/editor terminal captures match pi. Copy and custom new/tree/fork/resume shortcuts route through the existing session commands without submitting the editor draft; new-session rebinding preserves it as upstream does. The fork picker queries Session.getUserMessagesForForking and uses a dedicated immutable user-message component; native1/native4 mounted checks verify prompt restoration and isolated fork history. Empty-text user messages are excluded and successful forks show the upstream status notice. Focused terminal comparisons match the empty state, picker rendering/navigation, restored draft, success notice and edited model request; copy and basic chat regressions match too. Tree navigation uses a dedicated immutable component with upstream borders, semantic help, typed message previews, counters, filtering and native parent/child indices. Ctrl+x copies the full selected entry without closing the modal; raw nonempty trees can open when their initial filter has no visible entries. Focused terminal comparisons match the tree frame, empty-filter recovery, copying, preserved editor draft and following model request; fork shortcut regressions match too. Tree label editing uses native Input and persists through the session manager; label timestamps and remaining tree controls are incomplete. Ctrl+g and custom external-editor bindings use configured externalEditor, VISUAL, then EDITOR/nano. Scoped native terminal handoffs stop input, queries and rendering before launch, restore the editor text on a successful exit, and resume without repeating startup, reseeding history or reverting the current theme. Regular and fullscreen comparisons match successful, failed and empty edits and following model requests. Environment precedence, custom bindings and edits during streaming match regular-terminal comparisons. Native1/native4 repeated PTY handoffs verify cooked/raw input, visible cursor, stable descriptors and terminal restoration. Fullscreen selection copying and confirmation flashes, background suspension and clipboard-image shortcuts remain incomplete. Native1/native4 mounted terminal comparisons match label entry/cursor styling, word navigation, save/reopen/cancel/removal, preserved draft and the following model request. Resume supplies the live session to its modal so active-session deletion is rejected, including path aliases; component comparisons cover current-session highlighting and confirmation state. Interactive resume receives a typed loading context, opens immediately and uses progressive current/lazy All loading; the preloaded injectable backend remains available.
Native controller applies and previews themes, restores cancelled previews and handles automatic mode; the full upstream reload and terminal-notification behavior remains partial.
Built-in and custom theme loading, JSON-name discovery, sorted catalog and theme render equality are implemented; registered themes, reload and export behavior remain partial.

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/json.note: serializeJsonLine and the LF-only framing step of attachJsonlLineReader over decoded text; byte-compared with upstream in tests/rpc_protocol_check.py. Stream attachment and UTF-8 decoding belong to the callers (main.bend's stdin loop, RpcClient's stdout reader).

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/rpc-.note: RpcClient with every command method, start/stop of the child (SIGTERM, SIGKILL after 1 s), request ids, 30 s request timeouts, exit/spawn/stdin failures rejecting pending requests, strict JSONL stdout with StringDecoder-style UTF-8, stderr collection/forwarding, event listeners, waitForIdle/collectEvents/promptAndWait and getData. Adaptations: cliPath is the agent executable (not `node cliPath`); the transport is the injectable `send` (withSend); results are typed, decoded per command; events are their JSON values (json-event's JsonAgentSessionEvent); a spawn failure fails start() instead of the later send; requests still pending at stop() fail with the exit error instead of their timeouts; listeners run on the stdout reader and must not wait for responses or unsubscribe themselves.

All commands, JSONL framing, correlated errors, prompt/queue semantics, session replacement through the host, event streaming, per-line tasks (the reader waits for a line to finish or open a dialog, so extension handlers can ask the client), the whole RPC extension UI context (select/confirm/input/editor dialogs with timeouts and abort signals, notify/setStatus/setWidget/setTitle/set_editor_text requests, extension_error records), and command-context actions through the host. The prompt response follows AgentSession's preflightResult (success when accepted, the error when rejected first; later failures unanswered) and prompts, steers and follow-ups reach input handlers with source rpc. Gaps: the shutdown handler is not bound; stdout backpressure and signal handling belong to main.bend. See tests/rpc.md.

Typed RpcCommand (encoder), response envelope, RpcSessionState, RpcSlashCommand, RpcExtensionUIRequest and RpcExtensionUIResponse, with encoders used by the endpoint and decoders used by RpcClient and the endpoint's extension UI, plus wire codecs for bash results, cleared queues and the entry tree. Per-command response data stays JSON in the envelope and is decoded by each client method.

packages/tui/src/alt-screen-search.ts.note: The native immutable search index handles rendered-text normalization, cross-row and Unicode column mapping, non-overlapping matching and cache invalidation; the fullscreen keyboard search box and themed highlights match a focused upstream terminal capture. Mouse navigation, hover, full Input-component editing and the remaining upstream search assertions are open.

packages/tui/src/components/input.ts.note: The component behavior, including input, render, mouse and callback order, has source-replayed coverage for all 36 named tests plus native word-segmenter integration.

packages/tui/src/components/scroll-view..note: Follow-end, manual scrolling, scrollbars, and viewport state are implemented. Mouse-hover behavior, transient hide timing, configurable styles, and the full upstream suite remain open.

packages/tui/src/components/select-list..note: The five named source tests and supplemental action traces cover filtering, rendering, keyboard, mouse and callback order for the native component.

packages/tui/src/components/settings-lis.note: All named source tests and state traces pass, but Unicode fuzzy-search scoring is not established as source-equivalent and whole-terminal integration is separate.

packages/tui/src/editor-component.ts.note: The Bend editor component lives under components; complete source contract review is pending.

packages/tui/src/layout-node.ts.note: Native immutable layout nodes represent stack and scroll structure, including page, half-page, line, start, end and absolute-row movement of the primary viewport. The complete upstream layout contract is not yet validated.

packages/tui/src/tui-alt-screen.ts.note: Native fullscreen startup, typing, scrolling, and keyboard transcript search match focused upstream terminal captures. Search opens with Ctrl+Shift+F, shows themed highlights and counts, navigates with Enter, and restores the screen on Escape; the index reuses unchanged content. Mouse search controls, full input editing, mouse selection, image placement, and the rest of the upstream suite remain open. Light-theme scrollbar colors, top-of-transcript background resets, and fullscreen exit cursor/border styling still differ. Scoped external-editor handoffs render the natural layout document, retain the live scroll state and restore the alternate screen; editor-open, restored drafts and following requests match fullscreen terminal comparisons.

packages/tui/src/tui.ts.note: Focused review of live terminal preferences: native immutable TuiBase state and the owned process apply hardware-cursor and clear-on-shrink updates through the render scheduler; cursor disabling hides immediately through the owned writer. Native one/four-thread PTY checks exercise live visibility, consecutive independent updates, setter return order and terminal restoration. Scoped suspension now retires the terminal lease and its workers before invoking an external action, then reacquires it with separate initial/resume callbacks and retained component state. Native1/native4 PTY checks cover repeated successful, failed and empty editor handoffs, visible cursor and terminal settings; regular and fullscreen interactive captures and following model requests match upstream; regular captures also cover streaming during suspension. The broader TUI public API, named getter/setter surface, overlay/focus contracts and complete scheduling/input behavior still require source-wide review; this finding does not establish full TUI parity.

packages/coding-agent/src/utils/paths.ts.note: canonicalizePath, isLocalPath, normalizeWindowsShellPath, normalizePath, resolvePath (explicit Environment for cwd/home), getCwdRelativePath and formatPathRelativeToCwdOrAbsolute are ported and tested (tests/paths.bend, tests/coding-paths.bend). Gaps: getFileRevision stamps size and modification time only (no device, inode or change time primitive), and markPathIgnoredByCloudSync (setfattr/xattr cloud-sync exclusion) is not ported.

packages/coding-agent/src/utils/git.ts.note: parseGitUrl with splitRef, generic scp/URL/host-path parsing, unsafe install-path rejection and hosted-git-info candidates; matches the pinned implementation on the upstream suite and 714 differential sources (tests/git_url_check.py).

packages/coding-agent/src/utils/pi-user-.note: getPiUserAgent formats pi/<version> (<platform>; <runtime>; <arch>) from the system identity; the runtime token is bend/2.0.7 rather than Bun's or Node's version.

packages/coding-agent/src/utils/version-.note: LATEST_VERSION_URL request with the pi user agent and accept header, PI_OFFLINE and PI_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK, retry options, response parsing (trimmed version, packageName and note), comparePackageVersions/isNewerPackageVersion and checkForNewPiVersion are ported and tested over a loopback fetch. formatVersionCheckError cannot add errno codes (the native fetch error has none). No caller in the interactive mode uses it yet.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/package-m.note: Ported: resolve for local settings entries and auto-discovered skills, prompts and themes (patterns, overrides, ignore files, precedence, canonical dedupe); parseSource/parseNpmSpec/isExactNpmVersion, getPackageIdentity, addSourceToSettings/removeSourceFromSettings with settings normalization, getBaseDirForScope with the project-trust check, resolveManagedPath, getExtensionTempFolder, getTemporaryDir, getGitInstallPath and getManagedNpmInstallPath. Missing: package sources in resolve (install on missing, manifests, package filters, dedupePackages), extensions, install/remove/update through npm and git, update checks, legacy global npm paths, progress events, listConfiguredPackages and getInstalledPath; NpmSource has no `range` until semver ranges are ported.

packages/ai/src/providers/faux.ts.note: createFauxCore ported as a FauxCore record with Ref state (queued responses, counters, per-session prompt cache); helpers, usage estimates over UTF-16 units (walked by scalar, surrogates only materialized at a mid-pair chunk boundary), random token-size chunking, pacing, abort and terminal errors match upstream (tests/faux_provider_check.py, 22/23 named plus differential). Not ported: deferred responses (fetchDeferred/cancelDeferred, the deferred stream option) and fauxProvider/createProvider wrapping, since the port dispatches provider APIs statically.
